title: 2024年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
paperTitle: 2024年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
prompt: Suppose the university newspaper is inviting submissions from the students for its coming edition on how the students can contribute to a green campus. You are now to write an essay for submission. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: A green campus is no longer a slogan but a shared responsibility, and students play a key role in making it real. As members of the campus, we can turn small daily habits into real changes. There are several practical things we can do. First, we should sort our rubbish and recycle paper, bottles and cans, which cuts waste and saves resources. Second, saving water and switching off lights and computers when they are not in use can greatly reduce the energy our campus consumes. Moreover, choosing to walk, cycle or share bikes for short trips lowers carbon emissions, and passing used textbooks on to younger students gives them a second life instead of being thrown away. In short, a green campus grows out of these everyday actions rather than empty talk. If every student takes one small step, our campus will surely become cleaner, greener and more livable for us all.
keyPoints: 两句总起点题。本段落实第一段「总起点题」的功能：用 "A green campus is no longer a slogan but a shared responsibility" 一句拔高意义，再用 "we can turn small daily habits into real changes" 引出学生能做的事，正好套用了『点明意义』与『引出话题』两条句架。
分点加效果的主体。本段落实「分述具体做法」：先 "There are several practical things we can do" 总起，再用 First / Second / Moreover 领出垃圾分类、节水节电、绿色出行与二手书三条做 法，每条都跟一句效果如 "which cuts waste and saves resources"，做到动作配效果、不空洞。
收束加号召。本段落实「总结呼吁升华」："In short, a green campus grows out of these everyday actions rather than empty talk" 回扣开头的行动主题，末句 "If every student takes one small step" 用条件句发出号召并给出更宜居的前景。
